title: Frontend: Flatten Deep Object
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Flatten Deep Object. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(value). Flatten JSON objects and arrays into {path,value} leaves, where path is an array of string keys/numeric indices. Preserve Object.keys traversal order. Empty containers remain leaves.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use explicit node-type handling: arrays contribute index segments, objects contribute own key segments, and primitives become leaves.
alternativeApproaches: Preserve aliasing as reference records and explain why a tree-shaped path list otherwise loses graph identity.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Array/object mixture; empty containers; numeric-looking keys.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
